# CrossPoint Reader 1.5.0-32

This Xteink X4 Pro release speeds up HTTPS downloads and makes library indexing
incremental after synchronization.

## Improved

- X4 Pro now uses full-size TLS records and a larger heap-backed transfer buffer.
- Book downloads and OTA updates no longer inherit the low-memory 2 KB network profile used by X4.
- Synchronizing one changed book invalidates only that book's library index entry instead of rebuilding the entire library.
- Opening Deferred Books now indexes missing or stale entries immediately, without requiring a prior visit to Library.

## Notes

- The low-memory network profile remains unchanged for X4.
- This release is published for Xteink X4 Pro only.
